$comment: Copy to build.config.json and edit. Every step runs in PowerShell from workingDirectory; the build fails on the first non-zero exit code. Keep secrets out of this file - pass them as instance metadata or Secret Manager references resolved by a script.

steps.name: configure-nuget
steps.command: dotnet nuget add source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --name nuget.org --configfile C:\packer\custom\NuGet.Config
